samples.xml_description:
<module id="float_multi">
    <description>Implements IEEE-754 compliant single precision floating point multiplier.
    
    Design Notes:
    - Inputs a, b are assumed to be valid 32-bit IEEE 754 floating point values.
    - Outputs z should be valid after 2 cycles. 
    - The design uses behavioral statements to describe logic functionality.
    </description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal (active high).</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First input value in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second input value in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result of multiplication in IEEE 754 format.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>The counter counts through each step of the multiply pipeline.</implementation>
</module>
